mentions.name: VersionAlert
mentions.description: A software version tracking and notification service that monitors software releases and notifies users when new versions are available. It has launched a first niche product, VersionAlert for Unity, and a broader product is in development that will let people quickly find any software they want to follow via a smart search bar and easily sign up for notifications about new versions.
mentions.problem: Existing solutions for tracking software versions and notifying users about new releases seemed lacking.
mentions.audience: Users of software who want to be notified when new versions of the software they use are released
mentions.source_excerpt:
A way to track versions of ALL software and notify users about new version.

Started with a niche and launched it: VersionAlert for Unity (https://versionalert.com/unity)

mentions.name: VersionAlert
mentions.description: A subscription service that sends new version notifications for any kind of software, including desktop apps, drivers, and packages. Currently focused on a niche Unity-specific version that alerts users the moment a new Unity engine version becomes available.
mentions.problem: Knowing the moment a new software version becomes available; the builder values being at the bleeding edge, especially since much of their consulting value comes from breadth and depth of Unity engine knowledge.
mentions.audience: Unity developers and consultants who want to be notified the moment new versions become available
mentions.source_excerpt:
VersionAlert: https://versionalert.com

For a couple of years now, I’ve wanted to build a service that lets you subscribe to new version notifications for any kind of software—desktop apps, drivers, packages, and more. As a Unity developer and consultant myself, I’ve always wanted to know the moment a new version becomes available.
